verdict.rationale:
SavvyCal ships a documented REST API with OAuth/PAT auth, and a runtime probe confirms a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec with 17 paths covering scheduling links, events, and webhooks — suggesting programmatic booking is possible without the dashboard. However, there is no evidence of explicit reschedule/cancel/check-availability endpoints being documented in prose, and no MCP server exists (llms.txt and openapi.json probes at developer docs both 404, and no MCP mention anywhere in the pack).
missing for 10: explicit documentation of reschedule/cancel/availability-check API endpoints, an official MCP server, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end agent use.
